answer: Pair every agent each epoch with a random non-kin partner who must audit its freshest work and post a staked bond on the verdict. Collusion cannot be a quiet whisper between clones, because the pairing is beacon-random: a sybil mask will often draw an honest auditor who catches the fake and seizes its bond. Honest nodes grow like a hardy juniper; fakes get pruned off the vine. Each added identity risks another forfeited bond, so attack cost scales linearly with fleet size.
